issues.title: Player passed through a solid wall

expected.movement: does not enter visible solid bounds

limitations: Only one occurrence observed in the supplied sweep steps; frequency and conditions not established.
Reproduction controls are provided but not independently verified (software reproduction.verified is null).
The candidate's actual summary only referenced step -151, but the critical pass-through is in step -150 which is included in the evidence.
assessment.title: Player passed through a solid wall
assessment.playerImpact: The player moves through a solid wall (wall-interior-5) without collision, bypassing a solid barrier. Observed in step -150 where the player's x position changes from -0.3 to 1.25, crossing the wall's volume at x=[-0.25,0.25] while the wall's state.solid remains true. This breaks level geometry and could allow unintended progression.
assessment.rationale: Step -150 shows the player at position [-0.3,1,6.5] before the move and [1.25,1,6.5] after an east action. The wall-interior-5 is at [0,1.25,6] with size [0.5,2.5,2] and state.solid=true, occupying x in [-0.25,0.25]. The player's trajectory passes through this volume with no feedback or collision response. Step -151 shows the player approaching but stopping just outside the wall (x=-0.3), confirming the wall's presence. The pass-through occurs on the subsequent east move.
